Author: Jacob5800
Name: Retainer Pricer
Description: Automatically price eligible inventory and reprice existing listings one gil below matching competition using Universalis market prices and recent sale history.
Punchline: Automatically price new and existing retainer listings.
Changelog:
### 0.4.10.0
- Added an ETA to Sniper’s initial scan of all marketable items; background listening does not repeat the scan.
- Added an approximate Auto update ETA after the first retainer finishes; it updates as the run progresses.
- Added a Settings toggle for the clickable server info bar shortcut.
